proposal.summary: High-consumption AMI read rejections cause estimated bills, which drive the observed doubling of dispute ticket volume since August (E-01, E-12); reducing these rejections will lower estimated bills and dispute tickets (PD-1 root problem). Dispute ticket volume rose from ~600 in June/July to ~1260 in September (E-01) and 1184 disputed estimated bills were rejected for high consumption (E-12), establishing the link. No release was made; the release gate resulted in HOLD (assumption based on release gate result). The release was held because DA-RULES completeness is unknown while the release assumes completeness, and Layer 1 verification (safety predicate) failed (assumption based on release gate hold reasons).
